legend: In an effort to master their skills, participants in the programming championship regularly solve the "Tower of Hanoi" problem. All teams use the standard classical algorithm of moving, consisting of 2N−1$$$2^N-1$$$ moves.

We have the intermediate results that some teams have achieved. All results are represented as rows of length N$$$N$$$ (the number of disks), where element i$$$i$$$ of the string is the symbol denoting the rod on which disk i$$$i$$$ is located. For instance, let N=4$$$N = 4$$$. Then the record "BBCA"$$$"BBCA"$$$ means that the first and second disks are on rod B$$$B$$$, the third disk on rod C$$$C$$$ and the fourth on rod A$$$A$$$. The table below shows all the 7$$$7$$$ moves necessary to solve the Tower of Hanoi puzzle with three disks. Move NoDistribution of disks among the rods0AAA1BAA2BCA3CCA4CCB5ACB6ABB7BBB$$ \begin{array}{|c|c|} \hline \text{Move No} & \text{Distribution of disks among the rods} \cr \hline 0 & AAA \cr \hline 1 & BAA \cr \hline 2 & BCA \cr \hline 3 & CCA \cr \hline 4 & CCB \cr \hline 5 & ACB \cr \hline 6 & ABB \cr \hline 7 & BBB \cr \hline \end{array} $$ Write a program that will identify the number of the team with the maximum amount of moves in the Tower of Hanoi. If there are several such teams, determine the number of the first one.
input: The first line contains two integers: N$$$N$$$ – the number of disks and M$$$M$$$ – the number of teams that solved the puzzle. The next M$$$M$$$ lines contain N$$$N$$$ symbols. Line i$$$i$$$ contains the result of team i$$$i$$$. Each line represents the distribution of disks among rods A$$$A$$$, B$$$B$$$, and C$$$C$$$ after performing move K$$$K$$$ (0≤K≤2N−1)$$$(0 \leq K \leq 2^N-1)$$$. All teams use the standard classical algorithm of moving with the maximum of 2N−1$$$2^N-1$$$ moves. The number of disks N$$$N$$$ satisfies the condition 1≤N≤103$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^3$$$. Number of teams: 1≤M≤103.$$$1 \leq M \leq 10^3.$$$
output: A single positive integer – the number of the team with the maximum amount of moves. If there are several such teams, the team with minimum number of them is displayed.

legend.ai: 为了精进技能，编程锦标赛的参赛者会定期解决“汉诺塔”问题。所有队伍都使用标准的经典移动算法，需要移动 2N−1$$$2^N-1$$$ 次。

请编写一个程序，确定在汉诺塔中移动次数最多的队伍编号。如果有多支这样的队伍，则确定编号最小的那支。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数：N$$$N$$$，表示圆盘数量；M$$$M$$$，表示解出谜题的队伍数量。接下来的 M$$$M$$$ 行各包含 N$$$N$$$ 个字符。第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含第 i$$$i$$$ 支队伍的结果。每行表示执行第 K$$$K$$$ 次移动后圆盘在 A$$$A$$$、B$$$B$$$ 和 C$$$C$$$ 柱上的分布(0≤K≤2N−1)$$$(0 \leq K \leq 2^N-1)$$$。所有队伍都使用标准的经典移动算法，最多移动 2N−1$$$2^N-1$$$ 次。圆盘数量 N$$$N$$$ 满足条件 1≤N≤103$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^3$$$。队伍数量满足：1≤M≤103。$$$1 \leq M \leq 10^3.$$$

output.ai: 一个正整数——移动次数最多的队伍的编号。如果有多个这样的队伍，则输出编号最小的队伍。
